description: Parses a .jfr file and returns a structured summary: top methods by CPU samples, GC statistics, thread allocation stats, and anomaly hints (e.g. high GC count). Use for a quick high-level overview of the recording before diving into specific profiles.

events.description: Optional list of JFR event types to include. Default: jdk.ExecutionSample, jdk.GarbageCollection, jdk.JavaThreadStatistics, jdk.ThreadAllocationStatistics.

filepath.description: Path to .jfr file. Shortcuts: 'new_profile' (current, default) or 'old_profile' (previous). Or full path e.g. recordings/new_profile.jfr.

topN.description: Maximum number of top methods to include in the summary. Default: 10.

name: parse_jfr_summary
